The exact HFT trace connects the focus eater with 12:47 cultivation, harvest, and retention and 12:48 advance and protection; its unresolved contextual branches are retained as attributed activations rather than treated as absent.

The exact pericope trace joins the focus request, the court's declared interpretive failure, recovered remembrance, sending, return, and public knowing into one repair movement; unresolved context branches remain explicitly attributed.
The focus cattle branch that opens worked earth is contacted by the supplied grain carrier and by 12:47 sowing and harvesting, producing a distinct agricultural-infrastructure relation.

The focus truth title and request are joined by the later public truth inquiry, empowerment, storage, and guarding; the trace changes a private honorific into a tested credential that bears material responsibility.

The focus contains exact return and dryness carriers, while 12:49 supplies rain, relief, and expressed liquid and 12:50 supplies a second return; the double-restoration contact is specific and materially changes the return clause.

The repeated focus seven occupies the eater/eaten construction, and 12:48 repeats the severe seven as a consumer of what was advanced; the supplied predator branches therefore have an anchored, bounded personification.

The focus request is explicitly placed after the 12:42 delay and forgetting and the 12:45 recovered remembrance; the exploratory form-distance is contained as an abductive pressure around an otherwise ordinary request.

The focus fatness carrier is contacted by the repeated small remainder, storage, and guarding actions in the supplied pericope; the resulting divisible-reserve reading is exploratory but materially distinct from bodily fullness.

The focus lean carrier is contacted by the 12:47 and 12:48 limits on eating and the protected remainder; the trace supports restraint as a secondary discipline while preserving the ordinary emaciation image.

findings.title: Abundance is pictured as a stock under consumption
findings.claim: The repeated dream tableau makes counted abundance visible as a stock that scarcity actively consumes: fat cattle and green ears stand opposite lean cattle and dry ears, with the latter occupying the eater position.
findings.mechanism: The same sevenfold count, cattle, fatness, eating, leanness, grain ears, green growth, and dryness recur between 12:43 and the focus at 12:46. Their repeated arrangement turns a list of dream objects into a directed relation from productive fullness toward depletion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the dream's time-pressure as an active movement in which one condition feeds on another, rather than as four disconnected symbols.
findings.containment: The focus remains a report about seven cows and seven sets of ears in a dream. The staged consumption is the contextual relation made visible by the repeated wording, not a replacement for those concrete images.

epistemic.reason: The candidate is supported by trusted repeated-surface evidence and exact focus branch records, with a direct eating relation between the paired sets.

findings.title: The lean seven can take on a predator shape
findings.claim: The repeated seven can also take on a latent predator shape: the lean seven occupies the eater position, and the severe seven later consumes what was advanced.
findings.mechanism: The focus places the repeated seven before the eating verb and the supplied predator and prey facets make that relation personifiable; 12:48 repeats the severe seven with an eating action directed at what was prepared.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scarcity interval as an active force that hunts down and consumes prior substance, while the ordinary numerical reading remains fully present.
findings.containment: The surface occurrences count seven and do not name a beast. The predator is a bounded personification activated by the eater construction and 12:48, not a replacement lexical definition.

epistemic.reason: The focus predator and prey branches are supplied, while the severe contextual force is legacy-unbound attributed HFT evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: avlayan yırtıcı hayvan ve onun saldırısına bağlı durumlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, insanlara veya hayvanlara saldırarak onları avlayan dişli yırtıcı hayvandır.
branch_activations.carrier: The second focus seven is the delayed subject of the eating action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus eating verb and the later severe seven's eating occurrence provide repeated attack direction.
branch_activations.activation: The numeral occupies the grammatical position of the consuming force and is repeated in the later consuming interval.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Seven can be personified as an aggressive scarcity interval.
branch_activations.boundary: The number is not lexically replaced by an animal name.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: av olmuş veya yenmek için ayrılmış hayvan
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yırtıcının yakalayıp yediği canlı, onun avı olarak adlandırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus eating relation places the fat cattle in the consumed-object position.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The lean seven is the separate subject that performs the eating.
branch_activations.activation: The two focus components create the predator/prey asymmetry without changing the surface cattle wording.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The earlier abundance can be seen as prey for the later scarcity force.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the latent prey relation is carried; no literal wild hunt is asserted.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:48 severe occurrence carries the hard force of the later interval.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: That interval is immediately made an eater and repeats the focus seven.
branch_activations.activation: Severity supplies the force that lets the later seven act as the consuming counterpart.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The predatory personification extends from the focus dream into the severe interval.
branch_activations.boundary: The contextual force is attributed and is not given an independent gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Mal kalıbında temel anlam, malı harcamak veya bir amaç uğruna tüketmektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus eater carries consumption of a valuable stock.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later eater is explicitly directed toward what was advanced for the severe years.
branch_activations.activation: Predation and stock expenditure meet in the same repeated eating operation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The predator image also describes depletion of stored substance.
branch_activations.boundary: No unlawful taking is asserted; the branch is limited to consumption and depletion.

findings.title: The needed answer has nearly escaped reach
findings.claim: The request also carries an abductive pressure of an answer nearly lost: after delay and forgetting, recovered remembrance opens the gap between the court's need and Yusuf's response.
findings.mechanism: The focus request is carried by exact access-gap and out-of-reach facets, while 12:42 supplies forgetting and delay and 12:45 supplies recovered remembrance; these contacts surround the request with a restored access route.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel urgency inside the otherwise straightforward request: the interpretation is being reached after a route to it had nearly disappeared.
findings.containment: The ordinary request for an explanatory interpretation remains primary. This is an exploratory echo around the request, not the direct lexical meaning of the imperative.

epistemic.reason: The HFT source labels the inference exploratory and form-distant; its exact focus/context coordinates support an abductive echo, while its contextual branch records remain attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey kişinin erişebileceği alanın dışına çıkar ve kişi ona yetişip ulaşamaz.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus request is the point where the needed answer is sought.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The context names forgetting and a period of arrested delay before the request is recovered.
branch_activations.activation: The request meets the context's loss-of-access pattern as an answer being brought back within reach.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The appeal has urgency because access to its answer has already been endangered.
branch_activations.boundary: The out-of-reach facet is a contextual echo, not the direct dictionary meaning of the focus imperative.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birbirine yakın iki şeyin arasında sınırlı bir açıklık veya boşluk bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus request sits between the waiting court and Yusuf's answer.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Delay creates an interval and recovered remembrance closes it enough for the messenger to be sent.
branch_activations.activation: The physical-gap facet gives the temporal access problem a bounded relation between need and response.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The request occupies the narrowing space between an absent answer and its recovery.
branch_activations.boundary: No physical gap is asserted in the court; the relation remains an abductive contextual image.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:42 forgetting occurrence carries loss of the remembered route to Yusuf.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus asks for the answer after 12:45 explicitly recovers the remembrance.
branch_activations.activation: Forgetting and later request form the before-state against which the focus's access pressure is heard.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The answer has been endangered by a lapse in memory before it is sought again.
branch_activations.boundary: The forgetting role is HFT-attributed and not used to explain every occurrence of memory in the pericope.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:42 delay occurrence carries arrested movement during the period of blocked access.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Forgetting precedes the focus request and recovered remembrance follows it.
branch_activations.activation: Delay gives the missing answer an interval in which it can remain inaccessible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus request arrives after an answer has been held back by time and forgetfulness.
branch_activations.boundary: The delay role is attributed; no numerical duration is added.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:45 remembrance occurrence carries reopening what had been forgotten.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus request immediately seeks the answer that the recovered memory makes reachable.
branch_activations.activation: Recovered remembrance closes the access gap around the focus request.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The needed interpretation returns to reach just before the request is made.
branch_activations.boundary: The role remains an attributed echo and does not change the ordinary narrative sequence.

findings.title: Fullness can become a divisible reserve
findings.claim: The fatness adjective can also make abundance divisible: the full set becomes a reserve whose portions are rationed and guarded through the consuming cycle.
findings.mechanism: The focus fatness carrier supplies measured plenty, while 12:47 and 12:48 repeat a small remainder and 12:55 supplies storage and guarding; the supplied allotment facet turns fullness toward controlled distribution.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees abundance as something that can be apportioned, limited, and kept available, not only as undifferentiated bodily fullness.
findings.containment: The focus adjective still describes fat cattle. Allocation is an exploratory administrative resonance activated by the later rationing and guarding actions, not a direct gloss of fatness.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus fatness branch and context occurrences support the contact, but the HFT source is exploratory and its contextual allocation branches are unresolved and attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: fazlayı geri vererek ortaklık paylarını denkleştirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Fazlayı elinde tutan ortak, kaybı olan ortağa geri vererek payları eşitler.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus fatness occurrence carries measurable excess in the abundant set.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later instructions repeatedly reserve only a small remainder for consumption and preservation.
branch_activations.activation: Measured excess meets repeated limitation and protected remainder, making equalized shares intelligible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The abundant set can be heard as divisible plenty rather than an undifferentiated mass.
branch_activations.boundary: The allocation facet is exploratory and does not turn the adjective into a legal distribution term.

branch_activations.carrier: The two small-remainder occurrences carry a deliberately restricted share across the cycle.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus fatness carrier supplies the abundant quantity that is being divided.
branch_activations.activation: Small retained portions give the abundant image a measurable allocation boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Fullness contains a rationing relation that survives into scarcity.
branch_activations.boundary: The remainder branch is HFT-attributed and has no independent supplied gloss or facet.

branch_activations.carrier: The storehouse occurrence carries goods secured for later use.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus fatness is contacted by limited portions that require a protected stock.
branch_activations.activation: Storage gives the divisible reserve a place in which its shares can be held.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus abundance can be managed as stock.
branch_activations.boundary: The storage role is attributed and does not specify a physical inventory.

branch_activations.carrier: The guarding occurrence carries active protection of the stored reserve.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Storage and the small retained remainder supply the thing being guarded, while focus fatness supplies its abundant source.
branch_activations.activation: Guarding closes the allocation sequence by keeping the small share available across consumption.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Abundance becomes a reserve whose distribution includes a protected minimum.
branch_activations.boundary: The guarding role is attributed and no broader administrative program is asserted.

findings.title: Leanness can also carry restraint
findings.claim: Alongside the image of famine, leanness can be heard as restraint from eating that preserves a remainder: the later instructions repeatedly limit present consumption and protect what remains.
findings.mechanism: The focus lean adjective supplies the exact self-withholding facet, while 12:47 and 12:48 supply small eating and protected remainder occurrences; together they place disciplined limitation alongside imposed deprivation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can keep the painful emaciation image while also seeing the practical discipline required for a remainder to survive scarcity.
findings.containment: The focus still depicts lean cattle being involved in the eating scene. Restraint is a secondary discipline in the surrounding management sequence and does not romanticize deprivation or replace the famine image.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus restraint facet is qualified and the contextual smallness and protection records are legacy-unbound attributed evidence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yemekten kendini alıkoyma veya doymadan bırakma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi yiyeceği istediği hâlde iradesiyle kendini yemekten alıkoyar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus lean adjective carries the supplied self-withholding facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following answer limits eating in abundance and preserves a remainder during the severe interval.
branch_activations.activation: The restraint facet meets explicit consumption limits and protection, giving leanness a disciplined dimension.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Scarcity contains a practice of withholding that helps a remainder endure.
branch_activations.boundary: The self-withholding facet is secondary; the ordinary bodily leanness and its hardship remain visible.

branch_activations.carrier: The repeated small occurrences carry eating reduced to a limited amount.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus lean carrier supplies the restraint image that gives the limited amount a humanly legible discipline.
branch_activations.activation: Small consumption makes the focus restraint branch operative across both abundance and severe scarcity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The practical form of restraint is repeated limitation of what is eaten.
branch_activations.boundary: The smallness role is attributed and does not erase the explicit context of famine.

branch_activations.carrier: The 12:48 protection occurrence carries enclosing the remainder against consumption.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The lean focus and limited eating establish the need for a remainder that can survive.
branch_activations.activation: Protection gives the restraint practice a concrete purpose under scarcity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Leanness can be heard alongside the deliberate keeping of what little remains.
branch_activations.boundary: The protection role is HFT-attributed and does not turn hardship into voluntary virtue.

findings.title: Fātiḥa adds a provisioning frame to the crop contrast
findings.claim: The explicitly added Fātiḥa context places the focus's green and dry crop states inside a provisioning frame: abundant water, commanded care, and irrigation meet the focus's living and desiccated ears.
findings.mechanism: The focus green and dried-plant carriers are contacted only in Phase 2 by the external 1:2 Rabb water cue, the 1:4 water-command cue, and the 1:7 watering-and-repair cue; these add a source-and-care relation to the native crop contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the green/dry opposition as a condition of provision and loss within a cared-for field, while the native dream and reserve readings remain recoverable.
findings.containment: This overlay supplies a local provisioning frame for the focus crop words. It does not make the external Fātiḥa context a literal gloss of those words or assert that every Fātiḥa water branch is active.

epistemic.reason: The native crop contrast is trusted and the added context supplies exact compact water and irrigation cues, but the external projection has no independent review support or full facet payload.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Anlamın çekirdeği evcil veya yabani sığır cinsi ve bu cinsten tekil hayvandır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus cattle carrier supplies the concrete livestock side of the provision image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:7 occurrence carries the supplied favor/livestock cue.
branch_activations.activation: The external livestock cue contacts the focus cattle and places them within a provision relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cattle can be heard as provisioned animals within the crop tableau.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus cattle remain the dream objects; the external cue does not supply a new direct cattle gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tahıl bitkisinin tanelerini üzerinde taşıyan başak ve bunun tekil örneği dalın temel nesne anlamıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus grain ears carry the concrete crop object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:2 and 1:7 occurrences provide abundant-water and irrigation/repair cues.
branch_activations.activation: Water and irrigation contact the ears as the material surface on which provision becomes visible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The crop panel can be read as provision made concrete in the ears.
branch_activations.boundary: No complete theology of provision is inferred from the external cue.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam yeşil ve canlı bitki veya bitki örtüsüdür.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus green ears carry living plant vitality.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added context supplies abundant water, water-command, and irrigation cues.
branch_activations.activation: The external water set gives the green state a local provisioning condition.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Green vitality appears as provision received through a cared-for field.
branch_activations.boundary: The external branches remain triggers; the focus green word is not redefined as water.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bitki veya bitkisel malzeme nemini yitirmiş ve kuru duruma gelmiştir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus dry ears carry loss of plant moisture.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added water and irrigation cues supply the separate condition against which desiccation becomes legible.
branch_activations.activation: The external provisioning cues contact the focus dry state as the loss-side boundary of the same field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Dryness is newly visible as the absence or withdrawal of provision in contrast with green vitality.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus dry ears literally narrate the external Fātiḥa words.

findings.title: The added world-field widens the knowing clause
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa context widens the focus's public-knowing horizon: the answer returning to people can be heard against the world-field named by the added context.
findings.mechanism: The focus knowledge carrier at 12:46:22:1 is contacted in Phase 2 by the distinct external occurrence at 1:2:4, whose supplied surface is al-ʿālamīn and whose same-root world-field branch is available in the packet; this adds scope to the native relay without erasing its public endpoint.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the focus's hoped knowing as knowledge opening beyond a private court exchange toward a wider field of created life.
findings.containment: The external word remains its own occurrence and is used as a trigger, not as a translation of the focus verb. The overlay does not claim that all worlds become knowers or that the native court scene disappears.

epistemic.reason: The native relay support is legacy_unbound and the cross-surah trigger is compact context evidence without an independent connection record; the exact shared-root contact keeps the reading exploratory rather than grounded.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus closing verb carries people acquiring and recognizing knowledge.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added 1:2 occurrence names the world-field al-ʿālamīn through the same root family and supplies a broader referential horizon.
branch_activations.activation: The world-field trigger contacts the focus's learning outcome, widening the scene from a court's answer to the scope toward which knowing may open.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Public understanding can be heard as an opening onto a wider created field.
branch_activations.boundary: The external world-field is a trigger only; it does not replace the focus's people or assert that all worlds receive the same knowledge.

findings.title: The return acquires aid and a road
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa petition lets the focus's hoped return be heard as a supported, guided movement: the answer moves toward people through requested aid and a specified road.
findings.mechanism: The focus communication-return carrier at 12:46:18:1 is contacted in Phase 2 by the external aid occurrence at 1:5:4, the guidance occurrence at 1:6:1, the straight-road occurrence at 1:6:2, and the lost-path occurrence at 1:7:9.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the return as a movement whose success depends on help and orientation, while its ordinary social destination remains clear.
findings.containment: This is a local overlay around the return clause. It does not declare a whole-surah path channel, turn the messenger into a literal traveler, or change the direct meaning of return.

epistemic.reason: The native relay is legacy-unbound and the added path and aid material is compact external context without a reviewed connection record; the exact focus return contact supports only an exploratory overlay.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sözlü iletişimde cevap, sözü söyleyene geri çevrilen karşılık olarak kavranır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus return carries an answer moving back toward its people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added contexts ask for assistance, ask for guidance to a straight road, and name the danger of losing the way.
branch_activations.activation: Aid and guidance meet the focus's returning answer as the conditions that make its movement toward people intelligible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Return becomes supported and oriented movement rather than bare relocation.
branch_activations.boundary: The external path and aid cues remain triggers; the focus return is not lexically redefined as guidance.

findings.title: The added path gives eating an absorptive motion
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa path vocabulary gives the focus's eater a second motion: what is eaten can also be pictured as taken into a passage that absorbs what enters it.
findings.mechanism: The focus eating carrier at 12:46:9:1 is contacted in Phase 2 by the external straight-road occurrence at 1:6:2 and its compact swallowing cue, repeated by the road occurrence at 1:7:1; the contact adds engulfing motion to the native consumption relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the eater/eaten arrow as an enclosing movement into which the earlier abundance disappears, while ordinary eating and the native predator reading remain available.
findings.containment: The focus still says eating and the external road still belongs to the added Fātiḥa context. The swallowing image is a local cross-context resonance, not a replacement gloss or a claim that the focus contains a literal road.

epistemic.reason: The native predatory contact is legacy-unbound and the external swallowing cue is compact context evidence without an independent connection record; the exact eating carrier makes the overlay possible but exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, yiyeceği tüketme eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus eating verb carries the ordinary consumption action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The added path occurrences carry the compact image of passage and swallowing.
branch_activations.activation: Swallowing supplies an enclosing motion for the focus eater/eaten relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Consumption can be heard as taking the earlier abundance into itself along a passage.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal road is inserted into the dream, and the ordinary eating action remains primary.
